articles.title: DH Speak Out | November 2, 2026
Could Einstein’s equations explain the universe’s expansion?
articles.description: Researchers from UC Davis have proposed that dark energy may not be necessary to explain the universe's acceleration. They found weak points in the Lambda-cold dark matter model using Einstein's equations. By examining instabilities in Friedmann spacetimes, they suggest alternative explanations for cosmic expansion. Their work raises questions about the Copernican principle in the context of current models. This research could lead to significant shifts in our understanding of cosmology.

articles.title: Watch: After 9 years without a tricycle or pension, woman carries disabled husband on her back to meet collector
articles.description: In an emotional viral video, Bindubai is seen supporting her husband Dayashankar on her back, highlighting her unwavering dedication. Seeking a tricycle and a pension from the Madhya Pradesh district collectorate, Bindubai endures significant physical and mental effort in helping Dayashankar, who has faced paralysis and lost a leg for the past nine years. She yearns for the pivotal aid she has sought for so long.
